result.summary: The screen is largely coherent, but several visual inconsistencies stand out: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the current Home view, favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently and one is nearly invisible, restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel have mismatched image treatments and a name truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, and the second 'Popular right now' card is clipped by the fixed bottom bar.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) even though the visible content is the Home/discovery feed with address, search and restaurant lists.
issues.suggestion: Sync the active tab state with the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on this screen.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is a white outline heart inside a white circle over a light area of the photo, making it nearly invisible, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart. The two are visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white heart) and ensure sufficient contrast against any underlying image.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-word at the screen edge with no ellipsis, so the name reads as broken text rather than a deliberately peeked card.
issues.suggestion: Add text truncation with an ellipsis inside the card, and align the carousel peek so partially visible cards clearly look intentional (consistent gutter and clipped image only).

issues.description: Card imagery is inconsistent: the 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail sits on a very light grey background while the neighbouring burger and pasta thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, so the row looks uneven and the first card appears unloaded.
issues.suggestion: Normalise thumbnail treatment (same aspect fill, similar background tone/overlay) across carousel items.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20% badge) is abruptly clipped by the fixed bottom navigation bar with no fade or spacing, so its title and metadata are hidden and the layout looks cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the nav bar height to the scroll container so cards can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' twice — once as an image badge and again in the metadata line under the title — which reads as duplicated information.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery promo in only one place, or change the badge wording (e.g. 'Free delivery') to avoid literal duplication.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut mid-chip at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip row padding so the next chip is either meaningfully visible or fully off-screen, and consider a subtle edge fade to signal horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The decorative circles in the green promo banner are clipped asymmetrically at the right/bottom edges, creating an unbalanced overlap behind the 'Order now' button area.
issues.suggestion: Reposition or mask the decorative shapes so they read as an intentional pattern and never crowd the CTA.
